desc:
⚡ Welcome to Steal An Egg Genshin !

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from the sleeping guards in every zone
🐣 Hatch them and collect your favorite characters
💵 Place them on your plot to earn cash
🏃 Run on the treadmill to gain Speed
⚙️ Upgrade your treadmill, trails and base
🤝 Trade characters with your friends
📖 Fill your Index and claim free rewards
🌟 Hunt for rarer characters, Huge & Titanic sizes, and the global Secret & Divine eggs!

Grab the egg and run before the guard wakes up!
HAVE FUN!
